item.title: Gen A to Z: Tracking Kids’ Engagement on Netflix with Emily Horgan - ScreenMDM
item.description: On the heels of releasing the latest edition of her data-rich Netflix Kids Content Performance Report, Emily Horgan, media consultant and author of The Kids StreamerSphere newsletter, joins ScreenMDM Talks to kick off the April edition of its Gen A to Z strand.

item.title: Danny Robins' The Witch Farm Podcast Lands BBC Adaptation - ScreenMDM
item.description: Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha are set to star in an upcoming BBC supernatural thriller inspired by Danny Robins' The Witch Farm podcast, with ITV Studios handling global distribution.

item.title: Fremantle Lands Slots on Michael Jackson Doc - ScreenMDM
item.description: 72 Films' The Michael Jackson Story has landed a slew of deals across Europe and the Asia-Pacific, courtesy of Fremantle.

item.title: Up The Jammers Sports Docuseries Lands on ITV4 & ITVX - ScreenMDM
item.description: Up The Jammers, a series tracking Barrie Drewitt-Barlow’s takeover of the Essex-based Maldon and Tiptree Football Club, has been acquired by ITV Sport for transmission on ITV4 and ITVX this month.

item.title: Welsh Crime Thriller from Quay Street Secures BBC Commission - ScreenMDM
item.description: Old Town Murders from Quay Street Productions has landed a BBC and BBC Cymru Wales co-commission.

item.title: The Assembly Gets Second Season in Canada - ScreenMDM
item.description: CBC is on board for a second season of the unscripted format The Assembly, which features neurodivergent and autistic adults interviewing celebrities.

item.title: Meevee Preps New Preschool Streaming Platform - ScreenMDM
item.description: The Dutch children's media company Meevee is launching a preschool streaming platform later this month, targeted at being an alternative to "endless, algorithm-driven screen time."

item.title: Stingray Brings FAST Channel Slate to OrkaTV - ScreenMDM
item.description: The recently launched free streaming platform OrkaTV is set to add five video FAST channels and 12 audio services from Stingray to its offering.

item.title: U.S. Dominates VOD Catalogs in Europe - ScreenMDM
item.description: New data from the European Audiovisual Observatory has found that American content dominates content slates available in on-demand catalogs (across transactional, free, and subscription) in Europe.

item.title: ScreenMDM Kids/YA Digest—Edition One - ScreenMDM
item.description: ScreenMDM Kids/YA Digest, your once-a-month recap for trends in the kids and YA sectors, with news recaps, interviews, analysis, and more, launched today. You can see the debut edition here.
